entries.gap: This calibration has no matching 2024 population denominator for American Samoa, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands or the U.S. Virgin Islands.
entries.unit: vehicle revenue miles per resident a year
entries.estimate: Use the median of the 52 recorded starting rates; these are estimated territory rates, not measured transit use.
entries.estimatedFrom: ESTIMATED FROM MEDIAN for American Samoa, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands and the U.S. Virgin Islands: 8.85 vehicle revenue miles per resident a year, the median of the 52 recorded 2024 state, D.C. and Puerto Rico rates. Source: FTA National Transit Database 2024 (https://data.transportation.gov/d/ekg5-frzt); use the recorded rates because matching 2024 population denominators for these four territories are absent from this calibration.
